To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the ECOWAS has transformed from a sub regional economic organization to a security and conflict resolution body, but the economic agenda of the community has not been fully achieved.
ECOWAS is a sub regional organization with a mandate to promote economic cooperation among its member states.
ECOWAS has been able to achieve its objectives of political and security cooperation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the transformation of ECWAS from economic to political and security cooperation.
the role and transformation of ECOWS from a mere economic integration to a political and a security body dealing with conflict resolution.
the formation of ECOWAS and how the body has been transforming to meet up with regional and international challenges in the sub-region.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
ECOWAS has been able to achieve a lot in the area of conflict resolution and security cooperation.
ECOWAS has not been able to achieve its economic integration agenda.
ECOWAS has not been successful in achieving its economic integration objectives.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Economic Community of Western African States (ECOAS) has transformed from an economic community to a security and conflict resolution body.
ECOWAS has not been successful in achieving its regional economic integration goal.
ECOWAS is still a work in progress.
The main takeaway from our work is that
regional integration theories like Neo Functionalism, Intergovernmentalism and New Regionalism can be used to explain and understand the evolution of ECOWAS and its current status.
ECOWAS is a regional integration body with a security and political orientation.
ECOWAS should not be viewed as an all encompassing regional body.
